liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity declined by the same {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}}.
